versions.description:
Chat FAQ bot: answers the questions players ask over and over (how do I get money, discord, rules, next wipe) without staff typing it again.

- **Hook on chat messages**: the first enabled FAQ entry that matches answers.
- **Matching**: `any` (one word or phrase), `all` (every word of a keyword set, any order) or `regex`; case and punctuation are ignored; `word*` is a prefix match.
- **No spam**: per entry a server-wide cooldown and a per-player cooldown; messages shorter than the minimum length and commands (Takaro prefix plus configured prefixes like `/`) are ignored.
- **Reply mode** per entry: PM to the asker or public. If a game cannot whisper, it falls back to public (configurable).
- **Placeholders**: `{player}`, `{prefix}`, `{currency}` and your own (`{discord}`, `{rules}`, `{wipe}` by default).
- **Commands**: `faq` lists topics, `faq <topic>` shows one answer; `faqlist` (admin) shows all entries, modes, cooldowns and broken regexes; `faqtest <message>` (admin) shows which entry would answer.

Ships with a default FAQ set (money, discord, rules, wipe, commands, admin). Edit the placeholders and answers for your server.

commands.name: faq
commands.description: List FAQ topics or show one answer
commands.helpText: faq lists the topics. faq <topic or question> shows the answer privately.

arguments.name: topic
arguments.helpText: Topic name or question (default: list all topics)

commands.name: faqlist
commands.helpText: Shows every FAQ entry with match mode, reply mode, cooldowns and triggers. Needs FAQ_BOT_MANAGE.

commands.name: faqtest
commands.description: Admin: test which FAQ entry answers a message
commands.helpText: faqtest <message> shows which entry would answer and previews it. Needs FAQ_BOT_MANAGE.

hooks.name: faq-responder
hooks.description: Answers chat messages that match an FAQ entry

functions.name: faq-utils

permissions.description: Use faqlist and faqtest to inspect and test the FAQ entries.
